snippet.title: C:\indie games\Street Bike Fury\Shawn Noel\
snippet.description:
Street Bike Fury is a fast-paced, in-your-face, action game. You ride a motorcycle, kill a bunch of bad guys on motorcycles (and the occasional helicopter if you manage it), perform jumps and flips and generally cause as much chaos as humanly possible. It's a decidedly ambitious game and sadly, the last that Shawn made before he took his own life.

Download: http://shawn64.com/sbf.php

For more information about independent game developers: http://www.squidoo.com/indie-games
